name: Hesteel Serbia d.o.o. (Steel Plant)
description: Integrated steel manufacturing plant. Largest industrial facility on the Serbian Danube. Formerly US Steel Serbia, acquired by China's HBIS Group in 2016. Produces hot-rolled coil, plates, and sections.
effluent_notes: Cooling water discharge raises EC and temperature. Slag processing and pickling operations can release phosphates and heavy metals. Historically cited in Danube pollution reports.
source: EEA E-PRTR / HBIS Serbia public disclosures

name: HIP Petrohemija a.d. (Petrochemical Plant)
description: Petrochemical complex in Pančevo producing ethylene, polyethylene, PVC, and related products. Part of the Pančevo industrial zone.
effluent_notes: Process wastewater contains organic solvents and surfactants that increase BOD, depleting DO. Saline cooling water elevates EC. Pančevo industrial zone effluents historically caused severe Danube pollution events.
source: UNEP Pančevo Industrial Zone Assessment / EEA E-PRTR Serbia

name: HIP Azotara d.o.o. (Nitrogen Fertilizer Plant)
description: Nitrogen fertilizer manufacturing plant in Pančevo. Produces ammonia, urea, and ammonium nitrate. Part of the broader Pančevo industrial complex.
effluent_notes: Process wastewater and stormwater contain ammonium and nitrate compounds. Ammonia release increases nitrification load, raising NO3N downstream.

name: NIS Rafinerija Nafte Pančevo (Oil Refinery)
description: NIS (Naftna Industrija Srbije) oil refinery in Pančevo. Processes crude oil to produce petrol, diesel, LPG, and bitumen. Operates one of the largest refineries in the Western Balkans.
effluent_notes: Refinery wastewater contains hydrocarbons and sulfates. Hydrocarbon loading significantly increases BOD, depleting DO. Sulfate/chloride discharge elevates EC.
source: NIS Annual Environmental Reports / EEA E-PRTR

name: JP Beogradski Vodovod i Kanalizacija (Belgrade Wastewater)
description: Belgrade municipal wastewater system serving approximately 1.6 million people. Main outfall near Zemun/Novi Beograd. Historically lacked secondary treatment; partial treatment upgrades ongoing.
effluent_notes: Large municipal effluent load. Phosphorus from detergents and human waste. Nitrogen from organic decomposition. BOD increases deplete DO, especially in summer low-flow conditions.
source: World Bank Belgrade Sewerage Assessment / ICPDR Basin Analysis

name: NIS Rafinerija Nafte Novi Sad (Novi Sad Refinery)
description: Smaller NIS oil refinery in Novi Sad (Sajlovo industrial zone). Produces lubricants and specialty petroleum products.
effluent_notes: Lubricant manufacturing wastewater with elevated COD. Sulfate discharge from hydrotreatment.

name: Novi Sad Municipal Wastewater (JKP Vodovod i Kanalizacija)
description: Novi Sad municipal wastewater serving ~290,000 people. Combined sewer overflows discharge directly to the Danube during heavy rain events.
effluent_notes: Combined sewer overflows during storm events can cause acute DO depletion and nutrient spikes. Partial biological treatment.

name: Vojvodina Agricultural Region (Diffuse — Bogojevo-Novi Sad)
description: Intensive arable farming in Vojvodina plain. Corn, wheat, sunflower, and soy dominate. Heavy use of mineral fertilizers (NPK, urea). The Danube-Tisa-Danube (DTD) drainage canal system at Bogojevo discharges agricultural runoff directly to the Danube.
effluent_notes: Spring snowmelt and post-application rainfall events mobilise nitrogen and phosphorus from fields. DTD canal is a major conduit for agricultural drainage. Peak loading typically April–June.
source: ICPDR Agricultural Pressures Report / Serbian RBMP

name: Vojvodina Agricultural Region (Diffuse — Bezdan-Bogojevo)
description: Upper Vojvodina agricultural plain between Bezdan and Bogojevo. Intensive mixed farming with significant fertilizer application.
effluent_notes: Diffuse agricultural runoff. Elevated loads in spring. No point source discharge — purely non-point.

name: Djerdap (Iron Gate) Hydroelectric Complex
description: Djerdap I and Djerdap II hydroelectric dams (operated jointly with Romania). Major flow regulation infrastructure. The impoundment can concentrate pollutants and create stratification effects.
effluent_notes: Reservoir stratification can cause hypolimnetic DO depletion in summer. Impoundment concentrates EC from upstream loads. Not a pollution source per se — hydrological amplifier.
source: Djerdap NP Management / Romanian-Serbian Joint Commission

name: Smederevo Municipal Wastewater
description: Smederevo municipal wastewater serving ~70,000 people. Partially treated effluent discharged near Hesteel Serbia outfall zone.
effluent_notes: Combines with Hesteel discharge in the same stretch. Can cause compounding DO depression.

name: Ram – Banatska Palanka Agricultural Drainage
description: Mixed agricultural drainage between Smederevo and Banatska Palanka. Less intensive than Vojvodina but includes some livestock operations.
effluent_notes: Seasonal agricultural runoff. Lower intensity than Vojvodina.
